apparatus.guard: requiresApparatus: gen-c, enforced in bootstrap; every mode passes through it and the receipt records executed true/false

execution.comparatorExecutionScope: whole repository - jest projects: a default `test` project and a jest-runner-eslint `lint` project with testMatch <rootDir>/**/*.{js,ts}
execution.greenBaseline: 240 suites, 4809 tests, 9 skipped; exit 0 on two consecutive runs (run e2-16-eslint-plugin-jest)

measurement.cpuPrimary: CPU-seconds via /proc/self/stat cutime+cstime through execBounded; wall time reported separately
measurement.incremental: C_comparator - (C_diffci_selected + C_joint_analysis); joint analysis charged ENTIRELY to DiffCI
measurement.grossVersusFull: reported alongside incremental, never instead of it
measurement.installAndBuild: common unavoidable work, reported SEPARATELY; never counted as selection savings
measurement.crossRunComparison: FORBIDDEN. The same suite on one tree varied ~20% across runs (apparatus-qualification-gen-c). Only WITHIN-run arm comparison is sound.
measurement.denominator: the RUNNER universe, not the tree - defect 17. Selection fractions are stated against what jest executes.

stopRule.falseGreen: full arm FAIL and DiffCI arm PASS is a FALSE GREEN: disqualifying, reported at the top of the result, never offset by savings elsewhere
stopRule.recallUnmeasurable: stays in the denominator; hiding it inflates apparent recall
stopRule.noRedraw: no candidate re-drawn, substituted or skipped for any result
stopRule.noAnalyserChange: the analyser is frozen at generation C between sealing and result; any change voids the experiment rather than amending it

labels.RED: the repository own install, build or suite failed
labels.INFRASTRUCTURE: platform, container, harness or registry failure; nothing of the repository ran
labels.UNREGISTERABLE: the rule could not determine commands and refused
labels.NO_VERDICT: the run produced no repository outcome
labels.RECALL_UNMEASURABLE: the mutation did not change suite behaviour
labels.REFUSED: DiffCI declined to propose a selection

labelSemantics.layering: execution receipts carry outcome.layer (INFRASTRUCTURE | REPOSITORY | ANALYSER), decided structurally from the step the run died on, never from error text

state.statement: No DiffCI observation, selection, mutation or density analysis has been performed on this repository. The target was chosen from artefact checksums alone.
